text: GEM's unrestricted ___ schema asserts that every satisfiable condition φ(x) has a mereological sum: an object that is the least upper bound of the φ-things under parthood.
explanation: The unrestricted fusion schema, ∃x φ(x) → ∃z Fu(z,φ), asserts that every instantiated condition has a fusion (mereological sum) — the least upper bound of the φ-satisfiers under parthood. This licenses even scattered fusions and, with M1–M3 and SSP, gives GEM.
